integrity.proof_basis: Explicit attracting sets, a suffix-projection lemma, and pairwise-disjoint occurrence certificates for matching lower bounds.
integrity.unproved_extensions: No uniform result for every automatic sequence and no classification of every smallest attractor.
integrity.verification: Standalone Python 3 standard-library checks of actual factor coverage and lower-certificate regions; direct optimality enumeration for prefix lengths one through fourteen.

scientific_limitations: The exact all-prefix formula applies only to the binary characteristic sequence of powers of two and linear contiguous factors; uniqueness and enumeration of minimum sets, other alphabets, and other automatic words are not asserted. An unindexed prior proof cannot be ruled out.
title: Exact minimum string-attractor profile of the powers-of-two characteristic word
